name: Image Generation
description: Plan, generate, inspect, and save a local image using the configured image backend.

stages.name: plan
success_criteria: Prompt, dimensions, and exclusions are explicit.

stages.name: generate
success_criteria: A readable image artifact is produced.

stages.name: inspect
success_criteria: The artifact exists and matches the requested delivery dimensions.

stages.name: review
success_criteria: The user can accept or regenerate the result.
